verdict.rationale: Motion documents voice-based task creation: users can speak tasks into Motion, or tell Siri to add them, and the AI scheduler places them on the calendar. That is a real but narrow natural-language entry point; the AI Search Assistant and Workflow Builder are described without saying they accept natural-language commands. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can operate the product broadly (rescheduling, editing projects, querying, managing meetings), any documented conversational/chat interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Quickly create tasks with your voice, and Motion's AI scheduling algorithm will automatically put them on your calendar.
tell Siri to add tasks via voice command.
